title: [04/02/2023] A future plan about the Biology School in a particular university
prompt: The maps below show the future plan about the Biology School in a particular university. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The two maps illustrate the current layout and proposed future changes to the Biology School at a university campus.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while some key facilities remain in their original positions, significant modifications are planned, including the addition of new academic buildings and administrative spaces. The most notable changes include a reduction in green spaces and the introduction of new educational facilities.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: At the top of the current map, there is a cluster of trees leading to an indoor sports hall on the right side. In the future plan, while the indoor sports hall remains, most trees will be removed to accommodate new lab and office spaces, indicating a shift toward more academic functionality in this area.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Moving toward the bottom, the present layout shows a central library and drama centre in the middle, with two teaching buildings and various facilities including a cafe, lecture room, and IT centre surrounding them. The future plan reveals substantial changes to this area: the drama centre will be replaced by a music centre, an additional teaching building and lecture room will be constructed, and the IT centre will be expanded and relocated further south. Furthermore, a new staff car park will be added to the lower left section, displacing the currently wooded corner.
